baseline_models.focus_anchor: فلما زاغوا أزاغ الله قلوبهم ... لا يهدي
baseline_models.mechanism: The same deviation root moves from their intransitive swerve to a divine causative, while the heart root supplies turning and guidance supplies an intended course. The sequence is a feedback mechanism: an initiated inclination is made inwardly consequential and then persists as loss of direction.

activation_trace.role: Inclining away from straightness supplies both the people's first motion and the causative echo that amplifies it.
Turning and reversing makes the inward faculty the site where the chosen swerve is reoriented and fixed.
Course, manner, and intended direction makes denied guidance a lost trajectory rather than missing information.

changed_reading.before: The people deviate, so God punishes them by misguiding their hearts.
changed_reading.after: Their first chosen inclination enters a directional feedback loop: the inward faculty is turned along the course they initiated, and denied guidance names that trajectory becoming settled.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لم تؤذونني وقد تعلمون أني رسول الله إليكم
baseline_models.mechanism: Harm stands beside prior knowledge, so ignorance cannot explain the rupture. Knowledge is both disclosure and a distinguishing mark, while the messenger is something sent toward the addressees; harming him destabilizes a recognized delivery relation.

activation_trace.role: Disliked harm or unsettled discomfort supplies the concrete relational disturbance directed at Moses.
A distinguishing mark that points to something makes their knowledge recognition of an identifying sign, not vague familiarity.
Being sent forth and released gives the messenger a directional function toward the community that their harm obstructs.

changed_reading.before: Moses complains that people who know his office still mistreat him.
changed_reading.after: The people knowingly damage the recognized human channel sent toward them; the offense is sabotage of reception, not failure to identify the messenger.

baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated people-root holds the address and verdict inside one corporate frame. Its uprightness and support images meet the final image of a date leaving its peel: inward turning becomes failure to stand as a supporting people and eventual exit from communal-moral containment.

activation_trace.role: Straightness, uprightness, and evenness supplies the expected posture of the repeatedly named people.
Support and mainstay turns peoplehood into a load-bearing relation to the messenger rather than a mere ethnic label.
Essence and pure core locates the structural failure first in the community's inward core.
A date emerging from its peel gives the verdict a material image of leaving a containing form.

changed_reading.before: The verse ends by labeling the group disobedient.
changed_reading.after: The address tracks a people that ceases to stand as a support: its core turns, its upright corporate posture fails, and its members emerge from the casing that made it a coherent people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening ayah supplies creation in mobile glorification under precise divine governance. Against that field, the focus swerve reads as a local counter-course; the causative response is the governance of a trajectory after departure, not the source of its first angle.

activation_trace.role: Running and swimming supplies a field of directed cosmic motion within which the later swerve becomes a counter-course.
Tight making, mastery, and secure construction supplies the ordered governance of that moving field.
Inclination away from straightness provides the local angular departure from the ordered course.
Intended direction keeps the cosmic-motion analogy anchored in the focus denial of guidance.

structural_cues: 61:1 places all that is in the heavens and earth before the local human episode.
The focus فلما sequence assigns the first swerve to the people before the causative response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic swimming, mastered order, inclination, and direction; I infer an ordered-course -> counter-course -> governed consequence arrow. A live alternative is that 61:1 supplies only liturgical framing and no spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a self-contained moral failure and punishment.
changed_reading.after: It is also a local trajectory breaking against the surah's opening field of ordered motion, with the chosen angle becoming the course on which the heart is left.

context_deltas.mechanism: The duplicated question about saying what one does not do turns Moses's complaint into the immediate case study. Their recognized sign and their harmful conduct point in opposite directions; that practical fracture is itself an inclination away from truth before it becomes a turned heart.

activation_trace.role: The distinguishing mark supplies what their cognition already recognizes.
Concrete harmful disturbance supplies the conduct that contradicts recognized knowledge.
Uttered speech supplies the explicit side of the saying-versus-doing mismatch.
Bringing an act about supplies the missing practical realization against which speech is tested.
Intense aversion to an ugly act marks the mismatch as an active moral deformity, not a neutral inconsistency.
Turning from straightness and resisting truth pre-activates the focus swerve inside the divine-presence construction.

structural_cues: 61:2 and 61:3 repeat تقولون ما لا تفعلون immediately before the Moses episode.
61:5 itself places harmful action beside prior knowledge with وقد.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated saying/non-doing, known recognition, and harm; I infer that harming Moses instantiates the announced mismatch and that mismatch -> swerve. A live alternative is that 61:2-3 address a different audience and only analogically frame the story.

changed_reading.before: The people possess correct knowledge but separately commit a harmful act.
changed_reading.after: Their harm is knowledge failing to become action: the contradiction between recognized truth and embodied conduct is the first operative form of deviation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding straight rank, joined construction, and tight fitting reveal a positive communal body. The focus supplies its inverse: the repeatedly addressed people lose upright alignment around the messenger and end in the peel-exit image of فسق.

activation_trace.role: Uprightness and evenness makes the people-root the focus-side hinge for the preceding straight rank.
The date leaving its peel supplies the terminal image of a member exiting containment.
Alignment on a level line supplies the collective geometry that the focus people fail to maintain.
Building by joining parts makes solidarity a composed structure rather than mere crowding.
Tight fitting supplies the bond whose opposite is internal turning followed by casing-exit.

structural_cues: قوم frames Moses's address twice and returns in the no-guidance verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies level ranks, joined parts, tight fitting, upright people, and peel-exit; I infer bonded body -> failed alignment -> shedding. A live alternative is that 61:4's military construction and 61:5's historical people remain separate exempla.

changed_reading.before: فسق is a general moral classification after private hearts turn.
changed_reading.after: فسق becomes the visible structural inverse of the bonded rank: a supporting people loses alignment from the core outward and sheds the form that held it together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next messenger confirms prior truth and arrives with signs whose function is disclosure, yet the response verbally recodes them as diversion and deception. This sharpens the focus heart-turning into an epistemic reversal: evidence remains visible while its category is deliberately inverted.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark anchors the revised model in the focus claim that recognition is already present.
Swerve or failure of sight turns deviation into mis-seeing without requiring the sign itself to disappear.
Turning and reversing supplies the inward category inversion applied to recognized evidence.
False saying or attribution supplies the verbal operation that relabels the arrived signs.
Truthful speech supplies continuity with the prior message against which the false label is measured.
Disclosing meaning by speech or sign makes the evidence's clarifying function explicit.
Diversion and deception supplies the imposed counter-category that reverses disclosure into manipulation.

structural_cues: 61:6 repeats وإذ قال and إني رسول الله إليكم from the focus episode.
The arrival of signs is followed immediately by the quoted relabeling هذا سحر مبين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recognized marks, disclosing signs, truthful continuity, and a deception-label; I infer disclosure -> hostile relabeling -> inward category reversal. A live alternative is that magic is only an external insult and does not explain the focus heart mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They know the messenger but irrationally reject him.
changed_reading.after: Their deviation has an intelligible operation: they preserve awareness of the sign while reversing its category, treating disclosure as deception until the heart itself is organized by that inversion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus messenger is a channel sent toward the people. In 61:7 that movement becomes a spoken call inclining them toward safety, while fabrication and putting things out of place block the channel; repeated no-guidance language then names refusal of an available approach, not absence of invitation.

activation_trace.role: Being sent forth supplies the outbound channel that terminates explicitly at إليكم.
Gentle guidance toward a way or truth anchors the model in an offered route.
Putting something outside its proper time or place supplies the misplacement of the messenger's call.
Fabricating a lie supplies the false construction placed over the sent message.
Calling and inclining by speech supplies the available approach that the people resist.
Safety and freedom from damage supplies the destination paradoxically refused while Moses is being harmed.

structural_cues: 61:7 repeats والله لا يهدي القوم with a new terminal predicate.
The passive يدعى keeps the invitation present while the addressee fabricates against its sender.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an outbound messenger, a spoken inclination toward safety, fabrication, and misplacement; I infer call -> false covering/misplacement -> refused route. A live alternative is that ظلم and فسق are parallel labels without a shared channel mechanism.

changed_reading.before: No guidance follows because the people have acquired a disqualifying label.
changed_reading.after: No guidance describes a route actively made unusable by its recipients: they misplace and fabricate over the very call sent to incline them toward safety.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mouths try to cool a flame-like light, yet the light reaches completion and the messenger continues to be sent with guidance. This changes the focus target-effect relation: hostility can strike the messenger-channel, but its successful directional effect occurs in the attackers' own hearts while transmission continues outward.

activation_trace.role: The tongue as speech instrument anchors the later mouth image in the focus act of address.
The heart as inward faculty supplies the site where the attempted outward blockade actually takes effect.
A flame becoming still and embers cooling supplies the intended arrest of transmission.
Illumination supplies the transmissible object that hostile speech tries to arrest.
Opening the mouth in speech identifies hostile utterance as the attempted extinguishing instrument.
Reaching completion supplies the failed-blockade result: the light's process is not stopped.
Being sent forth carries the completed light mechanism into the repeated messenger-channel.
Guidance toward a way identifies the content that continues moving despite attempted obstruction.

structural_cues: 61:8 opposes plural intent to extinguish with God's present-participle completion.
61:9 immediately restates sending, messenger, and guidance from the focus vocabulary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech organs, extinguishing, light-completion, renewed sending, and inwardly turned hearts; I infer attack on channel -> failed outward blockade -> successful inward recoil. A live alternative is that the heart-turning and light-completion sequences are independent warnings.

changed_reading.before: Harming Moses successfully injures the messenger and is then externally punished.
changed_reading.after: Hostility fails to stop the sent guidance; its durable effect is reflexive, redirecting the hostile community's own inward faculty while the message continues toward completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later offer moves from profitable rescue of the self to protective covering and entry into tree-covered gardens. Read against فسق as a date leaving its peel, the focus verdict becomes exposure: the harmful swerve ejects the agent from a protective form, while the offered counter-trajectory covers and leads inward again.

activation_trace.role: A date emerging from its peel supplies the focus-side motion from protected interior to exposure.
Trade and seeking profit frames the counter-course as an offered exchange rather than forced relocation.
Deliverance by separation supplies rescue from the exposed trajectory.
The life-bearing self identifies the beneficiary and clarifies that the apparent harm to Moses rebounds upon the agents themselves.
A covering that protects supplies the reversal of peel-exit and exposure.
Entering an interior gives the protected counter-trajectory an explicit inward direction.
A garden covered by trees supplies the containing destination reached after covering and entry.

structural_cues: 61:10 addresses the same plural you with an offer that saves you.
61:12 orders the response as covering, entering, then dwelling within gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies peel-exit, rescue, self, protective covering, entry, and covered gardens; I infer exposure -> offered rescue -> protective re-entry. A live alternative is that the peel and garden images are unrelated lexical branches and should remain only a loose resonance.

changed_reading.before: The people harm Moses and receive an abstract moral status, while later reward language is separate.
changed_reading.after: Their outward harm is self-exposure: they leave a protective form, whereas the surah's offered reversal rescues the self by covering it and admitting it into a protected interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final messenger-community exchange supplies the positive inverse of the focus. Moses's utterance meets harm; Jesus's question receives a reciprocal answer of support. That response forms factions, after which divine strengthening makes one visible and uppermost; heart-direction therefore develops into social alignment.

activation_trace.role: Harm and unsettled discomfort supplies the negative community response to its messenger.
Support and mainstay exposes what the repeatedly addressed people could have been for Moses.
Mutual verbal negotiation supplies a completed call-and-answer circuit unlike Moses's unanswered complaint.
Aid that also makes manifest supplies the positive relational opposite of harming the messenger.
A gathered faction supplies the social body produced by opposed responses to the messenger.
Supported strength supplies the divine amplification of the faction that chose aid.
Rising and prevailing makes inward alignment externally visible at the end of the surah.

structural_cues: 61:14 repeats Jesus's قال and a plural reply, then explicitly divides بني إسرائيل into two factions.
The surah ends with believers becoming visible or uppermost, reversing the focus movement into turned hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harm, support, reciprocal speech, faction formation, strengthening, and outward predominance; I infer messenger-response -> inward direction -> social faction -> visible outcome. A live alternative is that the factional ending recalls 61:6 but does not specifically revise Moses's episode.

changed_reading.before: 61:5 records one people's private inward punishment for harming Moses.
changed_reading.after: It is the negative messenger-response template for the whole surah: refusing to be a mainstay turns hearts and constitutes one faction, while answering with support constitutes and strengthens the other.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because يهدي is ordinarily carried by the dominant ه د ي inventory, while the packet also resolves a rare non-dominant ه د د inventory. It remains valid only as a branch-resolved structural shadow anchored at word 21 and reinforced by the preceding building; downstream prose must call it an exploratory resonance, never a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: Collapse and breaking supplies the rare split-root shadow of what happens when guidance no longer holds the people on course.
Support and mainstay keeps the collapse image attached to the repeatedly named collective.
Joining parts into a building supplies the immediately preceding structure that can fail.
Tight fitting defines the cohesion whose loss casts the no-guidance clause as structural collapse.

changed_reading.before: The closing clause only withholds directional guidance.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root shadow, it also lets the unguided people resemble a once-fitted structure whose load-bearing cohesion collapses after internal deviation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The cross-domain move from أذى as a wind-raised water sheet to mouths acting on light is materially strange, but it remains anchored in the focus harm and speech instrument and in 61:8's explicit mouth-extinguishing scene. Render it only as an atmospheric analogy for hostile communal pressure, not as the lexical meaning of تؤذونني.

activation_trace.role: A sea wave or wind-raised water sheet gives the harm an exploratory image of surrounding material pressure.
The tongue as speech instrument attaches that pressure to the focus communicative scene.
Opening the mouth in speech turns collective utterance into the pressure-producing instrument.
Cooling a flame supplies the pressure's attempted material effect.
Illumination supplies the message-like object that the hostile atmosphere cannot extinguish.

changed_reading.before: The people inflict unspecified interpersonal annoyance on Moses.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their harm is a surrounding atmosphere of speech-pressure aimed at snuffing the message, while the actual displacement registers in their own hearts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch-distant هدي image of a swaying person walking with support. It stays anchored in يهدي, the repeated bodily inclination of زاغ, and the final divine strengthening of supporters; downstream prose should present it as a physical analogy for sustained direction, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أزاغ الله قلوبهم والله لا يهدي

activation_trace.role: Swaying or supported walking supplies a bodily model of guidance as being borne along a course.
Inclination away from straightness supplies the body's initial loss of balance.
Aid and manifestation supplies the interpersonal support available to the answering faction.
Supported strength supplies the divine counterpart to a gait that cannot remain straight unaided.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is abstract instruction that God withholds.
changed_reading.after: As a contained bodily analogy, guidance is sustaining support for movement: those who choose the sideways lean are no longer borne straight, while those who answer with support are themselves strengthened.

strongest_changes: The repeated زاغوا/أزاغ sequence became a feedback mechanism in which chosen direction is made inwardly consequential.
The saying-versus-doing prelude changed Moses's complaint into the surah's first concrete case of knowledge failing to become embodied fidelity.
The straight bonded building and the peel-exit branch turned فسق into loss of communal alignment and containment.
The clear-sign/magic sequence exposed heart-turning as deliberate category inversion rather than simple lack of evidence.
The final supporters scene made harming Moses the negative template of messenger-response, with inward direction eventually forming visible factions.
The forgiveness-entry-garden sequence activated an exposure/re-covering trajectory that coexists with the legal and social readings.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah behaves as a hinge between two communal forms: a people that knowingly converts recognition into harm, inward turning, and casing-exit, and a people that converts a messenger's call into reciprocal support, divine strengthening, and visible alignment. Material branches add live secondary models of course, structure, exposure, recoding, recoil, and supported movement without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the opening cosmic-motion model is an intended trajectory frame or only a productive branch analogy remains open.
The building/peel and cover/garden mechanisms are coherent but depend on carrying concrete branch images across ayat.
The failed-blockade model infers that hostility's effective result recoils inward; the packet supplies the target/effect contrast but not that arrow explicitly.
The ه د د collapse shadow and supported-gait reading are deliberately contained because their mapped or branch distance is high.
The verse permits judicial confirmation, permissive consequence, and habituated self-direction to coexist as explanations of أزاغ; the trace does not disambiguate them.
